$comment: The pull-request label policy, enforced by ../.github/workflows/pr-labels.yml; declaring a label here does not create it on GitHub.
policyMeans: A pull request carries at least one label from `labels` below. Extra labels beyond the set are allowed and ignored — the check refuses an UNLABELLED pull request, never an over-labelled one, because a rule that fails on a stray `question` is a rule someone switches off. WHICH label is right stays human judgement, exactly as the rationale half of a rule's provenance does (dod.md, condition 3); `covers` is the guidance, not a matcher.
$intake: Issue-intake labels, kept out of `labels` so that a pull request cannot satisfy the policy with one.

intake.name: bug
intake.description: Something does not do what the files say it does
intake.note: Already existed on the repository — GitHub's stock label, and the one case where the stock vocabulary says exactly the right thing.

intake.name: improvement
intake.description: A proposed change to doctrine, mechanism, or the shape of a file
intake.note: Named `improvement` rather than reusing GitHub's stock `enhancement`, which reads as a feature request for a product with features. What arrives here is usually an argument about a standard.

intake.name: feedback
intake.description: Confusion, friction, or an expectation the files did not meet — neither a defect nor a proposal
intake.note: The category that has no stock equivalent, and the one this repository most needs: a file that does not land is a defect in a product whose product is its files, even when nothing is broken.

$ownership: Who drives a pull request, kept out of `labels` so that `agent-driven` rides beside an area label and never satisfies the policy alone.

ownership.name: agent-driven
ownership.description: An agent drives this pull request. Ownership rides authorship; this label makes it filterable.
ownership.appliedBy: librarian.yml for App-filed pull requests; the opening session otherwise

labels.name: doctrine
labels.description: The engine's own doctrine: core/, templates, skills, personas

labels.name: mechanism
labels.description: The code that checks and enforces: cli/, spec/, plugin/, .claude-plugin/

labels.name: record
labels.description: The audit trail: handoffs, the changelog and its fragments in changes/

labels.name: infrastructure
labels.description: CI, workflows, repository and branch-protection settings

labels.name: dependencies
labels.description: Pull requests that update a dependency file
labels.note: Declared so a Dependabot pull request satisfies the policy with the label Dependabot applies itself. It cannot know this repository's vocabulary, and a gate that reds every automated security bump is a gate that gets bypassed. Same for github_actions below. Both already existed on the repository — created by Dependabot, not by this policy.

labels.name: github_actions
labels.description: Pull requests that update GitHub Actions code
